scope_candidates: expanded: all fixed-weight MatMuls with K/N >=16 (160), leaving four tiny output matrices floating
protocol.probe_budget: At most these two full naive INT8 candidates; do not select layers using numerical/test accuracy
protocol.trigger: If excluded-weight associated gemm layers exceed 10% of profiled F16 layer time at batch 1, expanded candidate requires a bounded pilot comparison. Otherwise review memory/storage benefit explicitly.
protocol.criterion: Prefer broader actual INT8 weight coverage if its warmed host-pipeline median is not more than 10% slower at batch 1 and 8; report all numerical drift without fitting scope to predictions. Invalid/nonfinite output, unsupported actual INT8 or major degeneration requires investigation.
protocol.limits: Layer times are instrumented; unfused MAC/weight-byte estimates are not measured DRAM traffic. No memory counter permissions assumed.
